info.title: PlayHive API
info.description: Public PlayHive game-stats API. Basic auth is optional on /v0 — authenticated keys receive additional fields; anonymous requests work too.

tags.name: Player stats
tags.description: Per-game player statistics, global counts and player search.

get.description: Hot drops, newest first: `[{UUID, name, type, total_sold, windows: [{from, to, stock}]}]`. `UUID` is the cosmetic id for `/v0/catalogue/editions/{id}`; `total_sold` is editions issued so far, `stock` each window's configured allocation. Window bounds are Unix seconds (UTC), half-open, null when unbounded. A drop is listed once its first window opens within 24 hours. Cached 10s.

Who holds which edition of a limited cosmetic (hot drop), in edition order: `[{edition, UUID}]`. Any cosmetic type; an unknown or non-limited id is `[]`. Players without a profile are left out, so a page can be shorter than `limit`.

V0Quest.description: A quest definition. On /v0/player/quests/{identifier} it also carries the player's progress: `accepted_at`/`progress`/`completed`, and `progress`/`completed` on each part.

special.description: Event quest; never on the hub board.

games.description: Game modes the quest counts in, e.g. `wars-duos`; `[]` means any game.

required.description: Amount needed; null on a multi quest's definition. In the player view a multi quest's `required` is its part count.

single_game.description: Single quests only: all progress must happen in one game.

reward_type.description: `quest_points`, `entitlement` or `item`; null when the quest has no reward.

accepted_at.description: Player view only, top-level quests. Unix seconds.

V0WishlistEntry.description: One wished-for item. `name` and `type` are null when the marketplace has no offer for it; the store fields are also null when that offer is not on sale.

UUID.description: The item's entitlement id: a UUID in practice.

added.description: Unix seconds when the player added it.

retail_product_id.description: Marketplace offer id, for linking to the store page.

limit_resets_at.description: Unix seconds when the daily accept limit resets; null when not tracked.

V0Error.description: Error body for 4xx/5xx without a more specific schema.

V0EmptyArray.description: Legacy PHP encoding of an empty object or a missing record: always `[]`, never `{}`.

globalCosmetic.description: Only when `global` is true: the resolved cosmetic.

default.description: Name of the category's default unlock.

experienceToLevel.description: XP threshold (as a string key) → level reached.

anyOf.description: Level (as a string key) → unlocks at that level.

unlock_data.description: Passed through from the catalogue; may carry more keys.

changeset.description: Raw stat keys gained this round, plus `level` on a level-up.

unique_players.description: Estimated player counts by game key; games with none are left out.

anyOf.description: One game's stats; keys per game are in the `V0Stats_<game>` schemas.

V0Stats_hide.description: `hide` player stats. Count stats are always present (0 when unplayed); string/list fields are omitted when unset.

V0Stats_main.description: `main` player stats. Count stats are always present (0 when unplayed); string/list fields are omitted when unset.

hub_title_unlocked.description: Unlocked cosmetics; item shape depends on `X-Hive-Api-Version`.

avatar_unlocked.description: Unlocked cosmetics; item shape depends on `X-Hive-Api-Version`.

costume_unlocked.description: Unlocked cosmetics; item shape depends on `X-Hive-Api-Version`. With `X-Hive-Api-Version: 2026-11` or a later date, each costume is `{name, render}` instead of its name, where `render` is the costume's render PNG url.

hat_unlocked.description: Unlocked cosmetics; item shape depends on `X-Hive-Api-Version`. With `X-Hive-Api-Version: 2026-11` or a later date, each object also has `render`: a 3D render PNG url, or null.

cosmetics.backbling.description: Unlocked cosmetics; item shape depends on `X-Hive-Api-Version`. With `X-Hive-Api-Version: 2026-11` or a later date, each object also has `render`: a 3D render PNG url, or null.

equipped_hub_title.description: Equipped cosmetic: a name, or an object depending on `X-Hive-Api-Version`.

equipped_costume.description: Equipped cosmetic: a name, or an object depending on `X-Hive-Api-Version`. With `X-Hive-Api-Version: 2026-11` or a later date, each costume is `{name, render}` instead of its name, where `render` is the costume's render PNG url.

equipped_avatar.description: Equipped cosmetic: a name, or an object depending on `X-Hive-Api-Version`.

equipped_backbling.description: Equipped cosmetic: a name, or an object depending on `X-Hive-Api-Version`. With `X-Hive-Api-Version: 2026-11` or a later date, each object also has `render`: a 3D render PNG url, or null.

equipped_hat.description: Equipped cosmetic: a name, or an object depending on `X-Hive-Api-Version`. With `X-Hive-Api-Version: 2026-11` or a later date, each object also has `render`: a 3D render PNG url, or null.

quest_count.description: Only for keys with quest access.

pets.description: Owned pet names. With `X-Hive-Api-Version: 2026-11` or a later date, each item is `{name, render}` instead, where `render` is a 3D render PNG url or null. A pet also has `nickname`: the player's own name for it (may start with a `§` colour code), or null.

mounts.description: Owned mount names. With `X-Hive-Api-Version: 2026-11` or a later date, each item is `{name, render}` instead, where `render` is a 3D render PNG url or null.

equipped_pet.description: The pet following the player in the hub, as `{name, nickname, render}` (same as an item of `pets`). Only with `X-Hive-Api-Version: 2026-11` or a later date; omitted when no pet is out.
